title: Move a window by dragging its title bar
preconditions: window exists and is not in a fullscreen space transition
pointer hit test resolves to the title bar (not to a control inside it)

states.enter: record grab_offset and origin_frame; raise window to front (activation rules in behavior.window.activate)
start animation.window.drag-frame at 0 ms delay (window follows the pointer 1:1)

on.action: set window frame origin = pointer - grab_offset, clamped to the visible screen
cycle to next space with the window (Mavericks drag-to-space)

states.enter: drag the window that is BEHIND the window under the pointer

on.action: move occluded window, keep the front window untouched

keyboard.action: move dragged window to the next space

errors.condition: window is not draggable (modal sheet parent, locked window)
errors.result: no grab; pointer events pass to the content below
window is clamped fully on-screen (Mavericks never looses a window off-screen)

gaps.what: exact drag threshold and whether a double-click on the title bar minimizes or zooms in the reference guest
gaps.issue: system setting dependent (Appearance > Double-click title bar to minimize); must be read from the guest's own preference

gaps.what: Xfce/xfwm4 equivalent of Cmd-drag of an occluded window
gaps.issue: xfwm4 raises on any title-bar press; the occluded-drag state needs a separate mechanism or an explicit compromise

notes: State machine is deliberately small: three states, two modifiers. Anything more is a renderer implementation detail.
